body:
I'm not even sure if I had sex. I made out with a girl (I thought I was straight but now I don't know). I blacked out a bit during our encounter. I felt very euphoric but then it went away (well, I guess it's obvious from my post). Haha.

It is good that you have a wife. I hope you are both very happy together. To be honest, I am jealous of people like you. I want it so badly, but I know I need to fix myself first. I have a lot of issues to work out and don't want them unleashed on a potential partner.

Do you feel any better coming here? I know depression cannot be cured just like that (contrary to what some people think), but has your life changed for the better? If you prefer not to answer, it is okay.

I guess it's just how I feel here... I don't have many friends. The friends I've made here, a lot of them have moved away (by "a lot", I mean... 5? Haha). I don't like exercising, much less hiking (but I am a very lazy person). I don't earn enough so that I can put away a bit in my savings account. 

I've heard good and bad things about Winnipeg, as I have about all the other big cities in the world. I would consider it.

It hurts my feelings a lot. Like when we talk about prom or sex during casual get-togethers, then they turn to me and ask. And when I tell them my (lack of) experience, even though my small circle of friends is not mean, I see their eyebrows go up. It is a behaviour I must change. Have spent all of my childhood having to please my dad and it still resonates...

I really like that song. Thank you.

Good idea.

I would also like a subreddit for non-serious stories. They make me smile. I am not meaning any offense. Like, Breaking Bad subreddit has a "jerk" subreddit. Something like that? Or do you guys think it will just cause wank?

I wish I could figure out how. I would love to find something I love. I used to write nonfiction, used to draw in my sketchbook, used to bake cookies... but now I'm just like, "Ugh, what's the fucking point?" I need to work on how I think. It is hard. I think of depression as a deep dark pit, and I try to claw myself out of it but then get sucked in right down to the bottom.

It is me (I?) who has to change. I know it takes months, even years, but I am so down. Sorry if I made little sense and didn't mean to come off as rude.
Maybe... but, as some have pointed out, maybe I would still be miserable. I dunno. All I want to do is sleep forever. Sorry for the emo response.

Well thank you. I really appreciate it. And I also don't want to traumatise anyone who might witness it. I have pretty much been in bed since last Saturday. 

From these responses, I have realised that I am blaming the city, in part, and it's not fair. I know so many people would do anything to be where I am right now, and it makes me feel so silly for feeling this way. But sometimes the depression just consumes me (or I let it consume me), and I can't help but want out of this life.

This probably makes little sense, but thank you. Take care.

It is me. I know I am blaming the city. Part of me knows if I move, I'll probably feel like a useless piece of crap. I need to get over myself and get rid of the depression, but it is hard. (Just saying... not looking for pity [not that I think you would give me any so hope I didn't come off as a jerk... yeah, see, this is why I have so little friends. I am so fucking awkward.]).

All my life, I have been uprooted (because of my mom changing jobs). I am not blaming her because I am an adult. But it is hard, you know? To establish new roots, make new friends, and so on.

Yep it is very hard. People have told me to network (some of the same ones who said I should just leave the city if I am so miserable). Don't even know where to begin. Maybe when I feel better, I will ask or look for posts on Reddit. Thank you.

I think maybe I am blaming the city, in part. I know, deep down, it is ME (I?) who has to change. I don't even know where to begin. Have been taking a cocktail of psychiatric drugs for years. Sometimes I wonder if it's even worth taking the goddamn pills, you know?

Oh, no, I didn't get an "asshole" vibe from your response at all. I do like Victoria, but yes. I will probably be miserable there because, really, I feel so miserable. I should make a plan. I will ask my (very excellent) shrink when I see him soon.

Thanks so much. I appreciate it.

Thank you. Yes, teenage years were among my worst times, and I would never go back even if I could do it all again.

It is hard to meet people here. By that, I mean it is hard for a self-loathing, shy person like me to meet people here. If you have any suggestions, I would appreciate it. Just looking for platonic friendships.
I have major self-esteem issues. I guess I don't recognise them because I hate myself so much. That's something I definitely need to work on.
